notes: Read-only audit. No source file, test, configuration, or dependency of the audited project was modified. One parallel sub-audit temporarily wrote a scratch report into .scratch/ and deleted it; the working tree was verified to match its pre-audit state apart from the audit report itself and pre-existing uncommitted changes.
round2_note: A second pass audited the test suite itself via mutation testing (delete a production line, see whether any test turns red). It added 12 findings (5 High) and CORRECTED a first-round claim: the suite is NOT hermetic. See finding #40.
corrected_first_round_claims: The first-round claim that all 146 cases are offline was wrong. tests/compatibility.test.mjs never sets DSH_HOME, so its 26 cases read and rewrite the developer's real ~/.dsh/dsh-opencode-free/catalog.json and really hit models.dev. Verified: that cache carries a live models.dev etag and 33 probe verdicts, and it was overwritten during this audit by pnpm run check.

Finding #4 is worse than first reported: the guarding test is vacuous. It passes no ttlMs (so effectiveTtl() falls back to the 24h default) but only advances the clock by 6h01m, so stale() stays false and ensureFresh() issues no request at all. Deleting the guarded fix leaves all 88 catalog tests green.
